items.title: Marty Grosz interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: I remember doing a thing once in Nice and they did, it was Harry Edison and, oh I can’t remember now, Buddy Tate and then probably Illinois Jacquet and Lockjaw and Johnny Guanieri.

ctx.x: Yeah. A lot of down time.

Yeah. But on the other hand, there can be miles and miles and miles of B flat. I remember doing a thing once in Nice and they did, it was Harry Edison and, oh I can’t remember now, Buddy Tate and then probably Illinois Jacquet and Lockjaw and Johnny Guanieri.
And I remember it was, they were doing a Basie set. It was supposed to be an hour long, or an hour and fifteen minutes like here. And they did two tunes. What was one of them?
